decisions.decision: Tom Lam will reach out to local vendors the town manager uses to price furniture.
decisions.quote: the budget was discussed in regards to furniture needs and cost estimates. tom would reach out to local vendors the town manager uses.

decisions.decision: Consensus that the transaction counters should have a separation barrier, with the town manager preferring a sliding window.
decisions.quote: we all agree that there should be because of covid there should be some sort of a separation, some sort of a barrier.

decisions.decision: Meeting room equipment (cameras and related items) is to be included in the cost estimate for the meeting rooms.
decisions.quote: it should be included in the cost estimate for the meeting rooms.

decisions.decision: Stage is not needed at this time to be included in the cost estimate.
decisions.quote: discussion took place on stage and that it was not needed at this time to be included in the cost.

decisions.decision: Studio equipment is handled by Steve Walker's group and is not included in the soft cost estimate.
decisions.quote: steve's group is taking care of the studio equipment so i'm not going to be including that in the soft cost.

decisions.decision: Dave Passios requested a future agenda item on the historical significance of the Passios building.
decisions.quote: a request for a future agenda item to discuss amongst the committee members talking about the historical significance of the passios building.

decisions.decision: Next meeting set for January 27, 2021 at 5:30pm.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Tom Lam estimated the kitchen equipment could cost $250,000 to $300,000 given the size of the space; a generic commercial kitchen is planned.
budget_items.quote: i would say with the size of what you have it may be talking about $250,000 to $300,000.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The budget was discussed for furniture needs and cost estimates; standardized flooring was preferred.
budget_items.quote: the budget was discussed in regards to furniture needs and cost estimates.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The design team has started the construction cost estimate covering hard and soft costs, with escalation a open question; construction duration estimated at 12 months.
budget_items.quote: ed disalvio: we have started the construction cost estimate.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: David Blatt said the interior doors needing fire rating and card access are very expensive; Tom Lam said keeping the doors with exit-only hardware is not code-required.
budget_items.quote: those are really expensive and it's a single floor.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Greg Roy said loading docks are expensive and hard to site on this building; the committee did not see the frequency justifying one.
budget_items.quote: i think that loading docks are expensive

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Discussion that repairing the chimney or removing it would be very expensive.
budget_items.quote: the chimney would be very expensive to repair and to take the chimney out.

budget_items.topic: Extended day and Community Link swap
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Tom Lam said swapping the extended day and Community Link locations makes no cost difference.
budget_items.quote: so cost wise is not going to make any difference.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Equipment for meeting rooms (cameras, vaults, security cameras, panic devices) to be included in the cost estimate; furnishings also discussed.
budget_items.quote: it should be included in the cost estimate for the meeting rooms.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Studio equipment is being handled by Steve Walker's group and is excluded from the soft cost estimate.
